nb2_lite.texto: Concrete jersey barriers and a steel gate blocking the red dirt road into Wittenoom Gorge. The barricade stands across the empty road, dust drifting against its base. Gorge access road between red ironstone cliffs, blue-grey tailings at the roadside, 2026. Cool dawn light, long shadows of the barriers across the road. Wide shot, low angle from road level, deep depth of field, 24mm lens. A grainy 35mm documentary photograph in the style of 2026, with muted colors and slight underexposure, in a dark-history realist style. The image has a 16:9 aspect ratio.
